questions.title: Is everything today's procedure needs in OR 4 and in service?
questions.why: FHIR lists what the procedure uses and where each device is; the scene shows the room. Present and in service lights green; a device listed but elsewhere is named, so someone fetches it before the patient arrives.

questions.title: Which devices are past their service date?
questions.why: Core FHIR Device has no service-due field, so the record carries it as an extension, the usual practice. Joined to the scene, the overdue machine turns red where it stands.

questions.title: How do I bring the defibrillator from storage?
questions.why: BOT knows which spaces touch; the scene knows where OR 4 is. The adjacency path is the route a porter walks.

inference.title: Roll devices up to the floor and the building
inference.why: BOT says the building has storeys, storeys have spaces, spaces contain elements. A rule rolls every device up, so a facilities view of floor 2 lights the same machines a clinician sees in OR 4.

fault_text: A non-sterile supply cart is pushed inside the sterile field, and the C-arm's record says it is still in storage.
